brief: A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Stacked full bases at (0,0,0) and (0,0,1) with snaps, forming two storeys (Levels 0 and 1). Additional half-bases at (1,0,0) and (1,0,1) extend tower footprint. Verified by piece:0,0,0;full and piece:0,0,1;full.
Two drawers placed on cut faces of half bases: drawer:0#1,0#cut at level 0 and drawer:1#1,0#cut at level 1 (both on north face of half-s bases). Provides two independent pull-out storage drawers.
Top level storage bins: bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full in full cell and bin:1,0,1~hex-bin-half-s-full in half-s cell, providing tray storage for bench items. Drawers provide enclosed storage below.

finish.summary: Built a compact two-storey tower (0,0 stacked full bases) with side half-columns providing drawer fronts on each level. Two drawers satisfy minimum, plus two top-mounted bins for open storage. Mesh check clear, no errors.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
